pick.name: Cloudflare Registrar + DNS
pick.why: No markup, free DNS/WHOIS privacy, same account as hosting

best_free.name: Cloudflare DNS (Free plan)
best_free.what: Authoritative DNS for a domain bought at any registrar
best_free.why: Free, fast DNS with DNSSEC and email routing; the domain itself still has to be paid for
best_free.free_limits: Free DNS zone; domain registration is never free

alts.name: Porkbun
alts.why: Low prices and free WHOIS privacy across a wide TLD range, including ccTLDs Cloudflare does not sell
alts.free_limits: .in $7.83, .com $11.08, .ai $82.70, .dev $12.87 renew; free WHOIS privacy + 20 email forwards

alts.name: Cloudflare DNS (free zone) with any registrar
alts.what: Keep DNS on Cloudflare even if registrar differs

decision: Cloudflare Registrar sells domains at cost with free DNS and WHOIS redaction, so renewals are the cheapest of the major registrars. It does not support every TLD (some ccTLDs such as .in are missing), so buy those at Porkbun or a local registrar and point nameservers to Cloudflare's free DNS.
details: No free option for the domain itself: every TLD has a registry fee. DNS hosting is free (Cloudflare Free plan). .ai minimum registration term not re-verified.

region_notes.India: Cloudflare Registrar cannot sell .in; buy .in at Porkbun (or an Indian registrar) and point nameservers to Cloudflare DNS.

verify.note: Decision and alts are built around buying .in domains (an India default). Rewrite for any TLD. Paid slot: no free domains exist, so name free DNS as best_free.
